svg.title: Four machines: input transport, rollback and fighter ownership
svg.desc: Each of four machines has one local person and controller. Three bidirectional UDP links connect P1 to P2, P3 and P4. Guests send their own machine inputs; P1 forwards other streams. Every machine simulates the full match. Projected history tiles illustrate four independent streams, not measured frames. Protocol 10 carries per-machine 16-bit controls. ReadPanel resolves the fighter owner using tag::Person and tag::Held, independent of point or partner role. Capacities and function names are taken from source 471f7f7. Four-machine internet and physical controller checks remain outstanding.

g.aria-label: One person per machine. Every machine runs the full match and rollback.
Transport does not choose the fighter.
Illustrative window / capacity = 128 frames per machine
Mismatch: restore, then rerun the predicted frames.
The host rejects a guest block that claims another machine’s identity.
